svg.aria-label: Reuse keys and values during decoding Decoder, KV cache, Attention Decoder — Project only token $t$ to $q_t$, $k_t$, $v_t$ → Attention Attention — Append $k_t$ and $v_t$, then read cache → KV cache KV cache — All keys $K_{\le t}$ and values $V_{\le t}$ → Attention Attention — Context for next-token prediction → Decoder Decoder — Project only token $t+1$ to $q_{t+1}$, $k_{t+1}$, $v_{t+1}$ → Attention Attention — Append $k_{t+1}$ and $v_{t+1}$, then read cache → KV cache KV cache — All keys $K_{\le t+1}$ and values $V_{\le t+1}$ → Attention Attention — Context for next-token prediction → Decoder Attention uses the new query with cached keys and values. Reuse saves projecting past tokens again.
svg.title: Reuse keys and values during decoding
